facts.fact: Established 1898 on land rented from the Rumford Chemical Works; host of the 1931 PGA Championship and the Northeast Amateur.
The club's 1916 crest shows a goat, an eagle, a fireside and the state seal (all avoided).

current.subject: A black hockey skate (developer's pick).
current.weaknesses: Static side view; the blade and holder blur at 1x.

concepts.name: The Hockey Stop
concepts.rationale: The skate tipped into a hard stop, a spray of ice off the blade.
concepts.tradeoffs: No link to golf or the club.

concepts.name: The Chemical Works
concepts.rationale: A glass retort. The club began on land rented from the Rumford Chemical Works.
references: Land rented from Rumford Chemical Works (fact)
concepts.symbolism: Old New England industry under a Ross course.
concepts.tradeoffs: Laboratory glass is an odd golf mark.

recommendation: Concept 1. The skate is the developer's choice and the cleaner icon.
